correctness.rationale: Summed columns along paths in K_n minus edge 01 span the sum-zero hyperplane, and the singleton adds the missing direction. On im T the map is (x,y)→(Ky,x) with K=DDᵀ, giving the displayed ranks by iterating from rank 2n. For odd n the complementary three-dimensional block has irreducible polynomial z³+z²+1, hence order 7 (its roots lie in the multiplicative group of F_8); the sum-zero tail block is fixed. Fixed dimensions for d=1,2,7,14 are n−3,2(n−3),n,2n by the swap and its seventh power. Subtracting divisor populations gives the stated primitive orbit counts, with positive 7- and 14-counts even at n=3 (where all states are already periodic). For even n put r=sum_{i≥2}e_i. The independent vectors e₂, e₀+e₁+r, e₁, r show the projection and nilpotent chain: more explicitly e₁+r is fixed; subtracting this fixed part from the four-dimensional block leaves a three-chain since K has ranks 3,2,1,1 there and Kr=0. The other n−4 dimensions are killed. The rank drops of T are N−2n,n−3,n−3,1,1,1,1,0, which give exactly the claimed Jordan lengths; stably it swaps two coordinates in characteristic two. The Fitting decomposition yields all entry shells and uniform phase-fiber cardinalities. An original bit-column iteration and GF(2) elimination for n=3,4,5,6,8,9 reproduced the ranks and fixed dimensions, and exhaustive state trajectories at n=3,4 gave the 1/7/56 recurrent populations at n=3 and n=4 entry counts (4,12,16,32,64,128,256,512). Read both frozen scripts and transcripts; they are finite diagnostics only.
